hero_eyebrow: Local Landscape Gardeners — Over 15 Years' Experience
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to stunning outdoor living spaces—we design and build gardens that work for your home and lifestyle.
services_heading: Complete Garden Design & Landscaping Services Across Birmingham
services_subhead: Whether you need a full garden redesign, regular maintenance, or specialist planting, we deliver beautiful, functional outdoor spaces tailored to your needs.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Bespoke garden plans that maximise your space and suit your lifestyle. We assess sunlight, soil, and your budget to create a design you'll love for years to come.

services.title: Landscape Construction
services.desc: Expert build of patios, raised beds, decking, pathways, and water features. We handle groundworks, drainage, and hard landscaping to professional standards.

services.title: Planting & Soft Landscaping
services.desc: Specialist selection and planting of trees, shrubs, and perennials chosen for Birmingham's climate and your garden's conditions. Instant colour and mature appeal.

services.title: Garden Maintenance & Care
services.desc: Year-round upkeep including hedge trimming, lawn care, weeding, and seasonal tidy-ups. Regular visits keep your garden looking pristine without the stress.

services.title: Overgrown Garden Clearance
services.desc: Reclaim neglected outdoor space with full site clearance, waste removal, and safe disposal. We'll reveal the potential hidden beneath years of growth.

services.title: Fencing & Boundaries
services.desc: Quality fence installation, repairs, and replacement. Durable timber and composite options that frame your garden and provide privacy and security.

about_pullquote: A good garden makes a house a home. That's what drives us every day.
about_para_1: R N B Gardening Services was founded on a simple belief: every home deserves an outdoor space worth enjoying. Over 15 years, we've transformed hundreds of Birmingham gardens—from tiny urban plots to sprawling suburban estates. We're registered with all major insurance and compliance bodies, and we take pride in turning vague ideas into beautiful, functional gardens.
about_para_2: Our customers trust us because we listen first, design thoughtfully, and build to last. We don't rush jobs or cut corners. Most of our work comes from repeat customers and word-of-mouth referrals—that's the best measure of what we do. Whether you need a spring tidy-up or a complete garden overhaul, we'll deliver quality work and honest advice.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About R N B Gardening

reviews.text: Our back garden was an absolute mess when we moved in—just overgrown weeds and broken fencing. R N B came out, drew up a plan, and completely transformed it. The whole process was smooth, professional, and the team was a pleasure to have around. It's now our favourite room in the house. Couldn't fault them.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: I've had them maintain my garden for three years now. They come quarterly, the work's always spot on, and the pricing is fair. No hassle, no surprises. Best decision I made.
reviews.author: Catherine M.

reviews.text: Had them design and build a new patio and raised veg beds. The design process was really thorough—they asked loads of questions about how we'd use the space. The build quality is excellent and they cleared everything up after. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Paul R.
